about_the_game:
Become a Mobster Kingpin in Drugs & Gambling!

Ever dreamt of striking it rich in a lawless world? In Drugs & Gambling, you step into the shoes of a cunning mobster, a survivor of the Slimepocalypse, ready to exploit the chaos. Build your criminal empire by running a no-holds-barred casino and dealing in locally sourced... goods.

Cheat the Odds: Rig Slots and Roulette!

Stack the odds in your favor! Rig casino games like slots and roulette tables to bleed your customers dry. And when they start to complain about their bad luck? Offer them something to... ease their worries. Get ready for some thrilling casino management and strategic manipulation!

They Won't Know What Hit Em: Use Locally Sourced "Goods" To Keep Customers Gambling!

Keep your customers blissfully unaware with your personally grown... *ahem*... "products." Hook them in, and before they know it, they're drowning in debt. Watch their liabilities skyrocket with a merciless 20% compounded interest rate! Master the art of resource management and economic exploitation to maximize your profits.

Employee Management: Keep Your Crew in Line!

Hire scavengers to gather resources for your... enterprise. Manage your employees carefully – a dip in respect can lead to theft. Teach them a lesson with a swift, decisive response. Just be careful, unwarranted aggression can breed resentment. Will you be a benevolent boss or a ruthless tyrant? Explore the dark side of mob management as you balance power and fear.

So, what are you waiting for? Dive into the gritty world of Drugs & Gambling and build your criminal empire today!

content_descriptors.notes: There is implied violence as well as drug use.
